'''2000 Naboo Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Naboo region (Eire, Scotland, U.K.) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00naboo">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=naboo 2000 Regionals: Naboo], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727135443/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=naboo Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Michael Riboulet]] of Bristol, England won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 4 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Harrier Public House 91 Bishops Rise Hatfield, Hertfordshire U.K.
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Peter Di Biasio]]
